record_title: Exact Weber Green modes and quadratic splitting in micropolar Couette flow
provenance: A source-specific exact reduction and sharp fixed-mode refinement of the balanced-viscosity sheared Fourier Green system in arXiv:2609.20109v1. The quadratic Couette symbol turns the scalar equation already derived by the source into Weber's equation, yielding a closed parabolic-cylinder fundamental matrix and explicit singular-value splitting.
limitations: The representation applies to the balanced-viscosity normalized coefficient matrix in arXiv:2609.20109v1. The sharp asymptotics are for fixed sheared Fourier labels and are not uniform near xi=0; they do not by themselves improve the physical-space Green estimates or nonlinear stability threshold. The full proof bodies of two closely related micropolar-Couette papers were not fully inspected and remain a residual originality risk.
